description: Search Google Scholar for academic papers on `<topic>` — returns title, link, snippet, publication info, and citation count via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_scholar({ q: "graph neural networks", as_ylo: 2020, num: 10, _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

as_yhi.description: Optional end year (results published up to this year), e.g. 2024

as_ylo.description: Optional start year (results published from this year onward), e.g. 2020

q.description: Search query / topic, e.g. "graph neural networks"

name: serpapi_google_scholar
